Frontend Developer

Cloudflare • Remote • Full-time

Job description

Cloudflare is looking for a Frontend Developer to build fast, reliable, and accessible web interfaces used by millions of users worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Develop modern, responsive web applications using React and TypeScript
  • Optimize frontend performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Collaborate closely with product designers and backend engineers

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript
  • Strong knowledge of semantic HTML5, CSS3, and responsive layouts
  • Experience with React and REST/GraphQL APIs

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with web performance profiling and core web vitals
  • Familiarity with edge computing or CDN concepts
